keywords.name: shader
keywords.documentation: Starts a plugin-owned opaque shader AST block. Open with Absolute: Open Opaque Block for virtual-document editing and breakpoint mapping.

keywords.name: mat3
keywords.documentation: Compatible with absolute.math mat3 float packing. Matrix types are uniforms, not stage inputs/outputs.

keywords.name: mat4
keywords.documentation: Compatible with absolute.math mat4. Emits mat4 in GLSL and float4x4 in HLSL/MSL.

keywords.name: storage
keywords.documentation: Declares a compute read/write storage buffer. Bindings are assigned as u0..u7 in declaration order.

keywords.name: workgroup
keywords.documentation: Declares the compute local group size for HLSL, GLSL and MSL.

keywords.name: kernel
keywords.documentation: Portable compute body generated as HLSL, GLSL 430 and MSL. Use id.x/id.y/id.z for the global invocation id.

keywords.name: hlsl
keywords.documentation: HLSL-compatible compute body retained for backwards compatibility. Prefer kernel {} for cross-API shaders.

snippets.label: compute shader block
shader compute desktop
snippets.detail: Run compute on OpenGL, D3D11, D3D12 or Vulkan

embeddedLanguages.documentation: Opaque shader bodies map to absolute-opaque virtual documents with host breakpoint line = block start.
